mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO marketing_account_occupancy (account_id, marketing_task_id, occupied_at, created_at, updated_at, tenant_id) SELECT a.id, mt.id, #{occupiedAt}, #{occupiedAt}, #{occupiedAt}, mt.tenant_id FROM marketing_task mt JOIN group_pull_marketing_task gp ON gp.marketing_task_id = mt.id JOIN account a ON a.id = #{accountId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE mt.id = #{taskId} AND mt.business_type = 2 AND mt.status = 2 AND mt.deleted_at IS NULL AND gp.resource_status = 2
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketing_account_occupancy o JOIN account a ON a.id = o.account_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN marketing_task owner_task ON owner_task.id = o.marketing_task_id AND owner_task.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN group_pull_marketing_task owner_gp ON owner_gp.marketing_task_id = owner_task.id WHERE a.account_group_id = #{groupId} AND o.marketing_task_id != #{taskId} AND ( (owner_task.business_type = 1 AND owner_task.status IN (1, 2, 5)) OR (owner_task.business_type = 2 AND owner_gp.resource_status IN (2, 3)) )
SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, business_type AS businessType, account_group_id AS accountGroupId FROM marketing_task WHERE id = #{taskId} AND business_type = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, business_type AS businessType, account_group_id AS accountGroupId FROM marketing_task WHERE business_type = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND marketing_template_id IN #{id} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO marketing_account_occupancy (account_id, marketing_task_id, occupied_at, created_at, updated_at, tenant_id) SELECT DISTINCT t.account_id, mt.id, #{occupiedAt}, #{occupiedAt}, #{occupiedAt}, mt.tenant_id FROM marketing_task mt JOIN marketing_task_target t ON t.marketing_task_id = mt.id WHERE mt.id = #{taskId} AND mt.deleted_at IS NULL AND mt.business_type = 1 AND mt.status IN (1, 2, 5) AND t.marketing_task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY t.account_id ASC
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id AS accountId, o.marketing_task_id AS marketingTaskId, mt.task_name AS taskName, mt.task_end_at AS taskEndAt, o.occupied_at AS occupiedAt FROM marketing_task_target target JOIN marketing_account_occupancy o ON o.account_id = target.account_id JOIN marketing_task mt ON mt.id = o.marketing_task_id AND mt.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN group_pull_marketing_task gp ON gp.marketing_task_id = mt.id WHERE target.marketing_task_id = #{taskId} AND ( (mt.business_type = 1 AND mt.status IN (1, 2, 5)) OR (mt.business_type = 2 AND gp.resource_status IN (2, 3)) ) ORDER BY o.account_id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM marketing_account_occupancy WHERE marketing_task_id IN ( SELECT mt.id FROM marketing_task mt WHERE mt.business_type = 1 AND mt.marketing_template_id IN #{id} )

DELETE FROM marketing_account_occupancy WHERE marketing_task_id NOT IN ( SELECT mt.id FROM marketing_task mt LEFT JOIN group_pull_marketing_task gp ON gp.marketing_task_id = mt.id WHERE mt.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( (mt.business_type = 1 AND mt.status IN (1, 2, 5)) OR (mt.business_type = 2 AND gp.resource_status IN (2, 3)) ) )
